frankfurter.title: Frankfurter exchange-rate API
frankfurter.summary: Query ECB reference rates, currencies, and historical time series without an API key; this collection covers the still-available v1.
frankfurter.stabilityNote: Read-only public API without authentication. v1 is superseded by v2 but remains available long term; its catalog endpoints are marked deprecated.

dida365.title: Dida365 Open API
dida365.summary: Use OAuth 2.0 to manage Dida365 projects, tasks, comments, tags, focus records, countdowns, habits, and check-ins.
dida365.stabilityNote: Official OAuth 2.0 API. Reads and writes require user authorization and are limited by the tasks:read and tasks:write scopes.

OAuth2.description: Dida365 OAuth 2.0 access token with tasks:read / tasks:write scopes. Enter it only in your own session.

credentialGuide.title: Create credentials in the Dida365 Developer Center
steps: Sign in to the Developer Center and create a New App.
Paste the callback URL shown by Pontx Hub into the app's OAuth Redirect URL.
Save the app, then copy its Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below.

massive.title: Massive stock market data API
massive.summary: Use a Massive API key to query U.S. stock trades, OHLC aggregates, unified snapshots, and ticker reference data; availability depends on the data plan.
massive.stabilityNote: Officially documented; availability depends on the account plan and market-data entitlements.

ApiKey.description: Massive API key, supplied only in the caller session.

yahoo-finance.title: Yahoo Finance web market data API
yahoo-finance.summary: Observed, unsupported Yahoo Finance web endpoints for quotes, charts, symbols, and fundamentals; some routes require a browser crumb and all are preview-only.
yahoo-finance.stabilityNote: Observed in Yahoo Finance web traffic; not a supported developer API and may change without notice.

stooq.title: Stooq public quote downloads
stooq.summary: Documents Stooq's legacy public CSV downloads and their current 404/browser-verification behavior; available for discovery and preview only.
stooq.stabilityNote: Not a versioned developer API. The latest-quote route currently returns 404 and the historical route returns a JavaScript browser-verification page, so neither is currently automatable.

sina-finance.title: Sina Finance web quote API
sina-finance.summary: Observed Sina Finance web endpoints for GB18030 JavaScript quote snapshots and 1–240 minute K-lines; positional fields may drift.
sina-finance.stabilityNote: Internal text/JSONP endpoints used by public pages; fields and encoding may change.

tencent-finance.title: Tencent Finance web quote API
tencent-finance.summary: Observed Tencent Finance web endpoints for mainland, Hong Kong, and U.S. quote snapshots plus adjusted or unadjusted day/week/month K-lines.
tencent-finance.stabilityNote: Internal text/JSON endpoints used by public pages without a version guarantee.

eastmoney-funds.title: Eastmoney fund web data API
eastmoney-funds.summary: Observed Tiantian Fund web endpoints: historical NAV and charts remain queryable, while the estimate route now returns a missing page and the related-index route is unstable.
eastmoney-funds.stabilityNote: JSON/JSONP endpoints used by Tiantian Fund pages; field identifiers are internal.

cnbc-market-data.title: CNBC web quote API
cnbc-market-data.summary: Observed CNBC quote-page REST and persisted GraphQL endpoints; batch quotes are callable read-only, while chart retrieval remains experimental.
cnbc-market-data.stabilityNote: REST and persisted GraphQL requests used by CNBC quote pages; hashes and shapes may change.

i3investor-sgx.title: i3Investor SGX public market pages
i3investor-sgx.summary: Reads i3Investor SGX HTML pages for quote, bid/ask, and range semantics; invalid symbols also return HTTP 200 fallback pages.
i3investor-sgx.stabilityNote: This is an HTML page-reading collection, not a JSON API; markup may change.
